sourceText:
Mandarin Orange Bread
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 8, 2009 - 11:12pm

Ingredients




1 cup sugar
1/2 cup margarine
2 eggs
1/2 small can frozen orange juice (3 oz.)
1/2 cup buttermilk
1 teaspoon baking soda
1/2 cup chopped nuts
1 small can mandarin oranges drained and cut up
2 cups flour
1/2 teaspoon salt

Preparation

1 Cream sugar and margarine. Add eggs and orange juice. Add buttermilk, soda, salt and flour. Blend well. Add oranges and nuts. Bake in greased and floured loaf pan for 1 hour in 350 degrees oven. When warm put on rack with waxed paper underneath and top with glaze made of 1/2 can (3 ounces) orange juice and 3/4 cup powdered sugar. Delicious!
